clues: This city lies in the south west of Anhui lands in China. It stands in the far corner of that part of the land.
Cold winds from Siberia can push night cold below freezing here. But summers turn very hot and wet, with long spells of heat.
A man born here helped found a great party in China. He led that party first, from 1921 to 1928, as its chief.
A sweet style of opera was born in this city. It rose to fame in the 1950s on the skill of its local singers.
That opera is a prized gem of this city. It marks the rich past and art of the whole place.
